BETA Close X Mears Group PLC has executed its share buyback programme by purchasing a total of 218,947 ordinary shares between April 22, 2026, and April 28, 2026, with weighted average prices ranging from 378.69p to 388.33p per share. These repurchased shares will be cancelled, bringing the total number of shares bought back for cancellation since April 1, 2026, to 516,431. Disclaimer* Mears Group PLC 29 April 2026 29 April 2026 Mears Group PLC Transaction in Own Shares Mears Group PLC ('Mears' or the 'Group') announces that, in accordance with the terms of its share buyback programme announced on 1 April 2026 (the 'Buyback Programme'), the Group has purchased the following number of ordinary shares of 1 penny each (the 'Ordinary Shares') through Panmure Liberum Limited in the period from 22 April 2026 to 28 April 2026. Date of Purchase Number of ordinary shares purchased Weighted average price per day (pence) Highest price per share (pence) Lowest price per share (pence) 22 April 2026 51,138 384.81p 388.00p 381.00p 23 April 2026 21,592 381.66p 386.00p 377.50p 24 April 2026 21,888 378.69p 380.50p 377.00p 27 April 2026 63,911 386.08p 387.50p 380.50p 28 April 2026 41,318 388.33p 390.00p 386.50p The purchased Ordinary Shares will be cancelled. Since the announcement of the Buyback Programme on 1 April 2026, Mears has purchased 516,431 Ordinary Shares in aggregate for cancellation.
